text: The first 6 months of employment will constitute a probationary period, during which the Company may terminate the employment with 14 days' written notice. After the probationary period, the notice period will be 30 days. You will be entitled to 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
description: 'either party may terminate' changed to 'the Company may terminate'. The employee loses the right to terminate during probation, which changes who holds the right.

text: Your employment will commence on April 1, 2026. You will work 40 hours per week at our Dublin office, with the requirement to work remotely at least 2 days per week.
description: 'the option of working remotely for up to 2 days' changed to 'the requirement to work remotely at least 2 days'. An optional maximum becomes a mandatory minimum.

text: You will receive an annual net base salary of EUR 95,000.00, payable in 12 equal monthly instalments. Your base salary will be reviewed once a year.
description: 'gross base salary' replaced with 'net base salary'. Net (after tax) is a different and higher entitlement than gross.

text: Please confirm your acceptance of this offer by signing and returning this letter no later than March 2, 2026. Upon your request, this deadline will be extended automatically. If we do not receive your signed acceptance by that date, this offer will lapse.
description: Added the sentence 'Upon your request, this deadline will be extended automatically.' This creates a deadline-extension right that is not in the original.

text: You will be eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 15% of your base salary, based on the achievement of individual and company objectives.
description: Removed the entire sentence about the one-time signing bonus of EUR 5,000.00 payable with the first monthly salary.

text: Dear Elena Marquez, on behalf of Brightwater Data Solutions Ltd., we are delighted to offer you the position of Senior Data Engineer, reporting to Thomas Reed, Head of Data Platform. This offer is dated February 16, 2026.
description: 'pleased' replaced with the synonym 'delighted'. The meaning is identical, so this is not an error.

text: You will receive an annual gross base salary of EUR 95,000.00, payable in 12 equal monthly instalments. Your base salary will be reviewed annually.
description: 'once a year' replaced with the equivalent 'annually'. The meaning is identical, so this is not an error.
